read_by.transcription: independent readers working only from the page renders, without table data
read_by.verification: the curator fitted every control on the committed renders (verify/circlefit.py: the three jet bumper caps on the switch and solenoid drawings, the two lower flipper pivots on all three, and on the lamp drawing, which draws no jet bumpers, the four rollover buttons) and checked each on zoomed crops; added on every page the drawn playfield frame's top-left, top-right and bottom-left corners (verify/frame_corners.py: the outer frame lines' intersection), which match the table bounds within 0.013 leave-one-out, and, because the bottom-right corner is not drawn (the outline steps in at the shooter lane), the ball shooter switch 38 slot at the foot of the shooter lane (verify/slot_centre.py: centred between the walls' inner edges and midway between the rounded top's inner apex and the lane's bottom edge line; within 0.005 of the table trigger on every page), so every measured socket lies inside the convex hull of its page's controls; replaced the solenoid reader's jet-bumper controls, which had taken the top-lane guides for the bumpers; overlaid all three pages with the final placements (overlay-*.png); relabelled the solenoid drawing's paired balloons 8/16 and 23/24, each pair drawn touching with one shared leader; replaced the lamp-53 read, an arrowhead touching the kidney-shaped GOAL insert's outline, with the insert's flood-filled centroid (verify/kidney_centroid.py); measured on the drawings, from fitted circle centres or leader ends, the twelve sockets the table does not model where the drawing puts them (measurements.json); and excluded switch 65, which the switch drawing never numbers, as well as the projections and the Not Shown flipper coils

drawing_callout_check.rule: A placement is validated when its own callout on the factory location drawing (each callout paired with at most one placement of its label, nearest first) lands within 0.07 normalized of it under two least-squares fits of that page: one on independently read controls (jet-bumper caps and flipper pivots, or another crisp mechanism feature where balloons hide a pivot), and one, measured leave-one-out, on the page's other callout reads, from which any read beyond the limit is dropped. Placements without such a read keep their table status. Placements measured on a drawing are never checked against it.

projections.reason: Projected onto the trough eject Kicker (Trigger/Kicker sw31, table object center): the retained script's SolTrough handler fires sw31.kick and vpmTimer.PulseSw 36 in the same event (no separate playfield object represents Trough Stack), and pinned PinMAME's own sim ball-routing table (wcs_stateDef) places the 'Trough stack' state immediately after the 'Trough 1' eject state in the ball's path toward the shooter lane.

Projected onto the rotating goalie figure (Primitive BM_goalkeeper, table object center): the retained script's InitGoalie sets BP_goalkeeper.x=376/.y=280, matching this primitive's own position (374.4,281.5) almost exactly, and wcs_handleMech sets public switches 43/44 directly from the DC-motor position counter (mech_getPos(0)) rather than from a fixed playfield sensor object.
Projected onto the rotating goalie figure (Primitive BM_goalkeeper, table object center); see switch 43.

Projected onto the goalie figure (Primitive BM_goalkeeper, table object center), the target this switch senses: the Goalie Target (A-17779) is the goalie figure itself, the switch drawing (printed 2-47) ends callout 48's leader on the goalie unit, and the retained script's GWalls_Hit handler pulses public 48 whenever a ball strikes whichever segment of the goalie's 35-segment hit ring (HitTarget GT006-GT040) is currently collidable. That ring moves with the figure and has no fixed playfield sensor object of its own. An earlier pass projected this switch onto the shooter-lane plunger trigger, which is unrelated to the goalie.
